title: Constructibility from constructible finite stalk cardinality loci
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme and F an abelian etale sheaf with finite geometric stalks. If every positive stalk-cardinality locus is constructible, then F is constructible.

proof.text: Use Noetherian induction on closed subsets. On a nonempty irreducible open, the generic stalk and constructibility of its cardinality locus give a nonempty open where cardinality is constant; lift the finite stalk and its addition table to a common pointed etale neighbourhood, extend to a constant sheaf map, and use the zero-germ argument to prove it is an isomorphism on a smaller open. The complement is proper closed and is handled by induction; concatenate the open and closed stratifications.
